headline: Large mobile element and phage catalogues enable association analyses of variable microbial gene content
label: Microbial Mobilome And Pangenome Catalogues
summary: New catalogues of mobile elements and gut phages, plus tooling for prophage analysis, support linking variable gene content to hosts, plasmids and metabolites.
synthesis: The dominant thread is structured cataloguing of variable microbial gene content at scales that support downstream association analyses. proMGE2 catalogues over 16.4 million mobile genetic elements from isolate genomes and MAGs across habitats, with a 5-million-sequence non-redundant set. A metagenomic study of 1,069 TwinsUK gut samples builds a 116,740-vOTU phage catalogue and links phage genomic variation to bacterial species and microbial metabolites. PHI packages prophage identification, quality assessment, host prediction and functional annotation in a Galaxy workflow with standardized reporting. An ETEC study addresses how plasmid-host associations shape colonization-factor distribution. Peripheral items include MiSA, a statistical framework for spatial dysbiosis in HiPR-FISH images, and metabolic modelling of 105 C. difficile strains in which diet outweighs strain differences in commensal interactions.
